instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: postburn hypertrophic scarring severity measurement
items.definition: quantification of the severity of hypertrophic scarring in burn patients, usually using the Vancouver Scar Scale (VSS)

items.label: atopic march
items.definition: sequential manifestations of different allergic diseases such as eczema, asthma and rhinitis. Typically, eczema is the first allergic disease in infancy, followed by asthma and/or rhinitis in childhood.

items.label: Staphylococcus aureus carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the presence or absence of Staphylococcus aureus colonies in an individual. Positive carrier status should not be equated with infection.

items.label: persistent Staphylococcus aureus carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the consistent presence or absence of Staphylococcus aureus colonies in an individual at at least two separate points in time

items.label: intermittent Staphylococcus aureus carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the change in presence or absence of Staphylococcus aureus colonies in an individual at two different points in time, from positive to negative or negative to positve

items.label: post-operative fentanyl consumption measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of fentanyl, an opiate, consumed within the first 24hrs after a surgical intervention

items.label: pathologic complete response measurement
items.definition: quantification of  the absence of residual invasive disease in the breast and in the axillary lymph nodes at the completion of the neoadjuvant treatment

items.label: cutaneous psoriasis measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence or absence of psoriatic arthritis in patients with psoriasis vulgaris

items.label: thrombin-antithrombin complex measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of thrombin-antithrombin complex in a sample

items.label: base metabolic rate measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's base metabolic rate, the minimum amount of energy required to sustain life while at complete rest, including the body being in a post-absorptive state (ie the digestive system is inactive). items.label: periodontal measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of periodontitis or periodontal examinations, including acute vs chronic status, interproximal clincial attachement level and others

items.label: mosaic loss of chromosome Y measurement
functional decline measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of muscle function deterioration such as the rate at which it occurs or its severity, for example in patients with neurodegenerative conditions such as ALS. Functional decline is ususally assessed using a combination of physical exams and structured-interview protocols

items.label: BMI-adjusted waist circumference
items.definition: waist circumference measurement that has been adjusted by subjects’ body mass index

items.label: rheumatoid factor seropositivity measurement
items.definition: rheumatoid factor seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating  autoantibodies called rheumatoid factors that contribute to a number of autoimmune diseases including rheumatoid arthritis

items.label: antipsychotic drug use measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of antipsychotic drug use such as drug dosage

items.label: BMI-adjusted leptin measurement
items.definition: leptin measurement that has been adjusted for subjects' body mass index

items.label: nicotine metabolite ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of 3’-trans-hydroxycotinine to cotinine in a sample, typically in a urine or blood sample

items.label: parental longevity
items.definition: length of an individual's parents' life, either taken individually (paternal or maternal longevity) or in combination and sometimes used as an indicator of an individual longevity

items.label: language measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of language or language development

items.label: linguistic error measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's linguistic error rate, generally through the administration of standardised tests or the analysis of language samples by a specialist

items.label: syntactic complexity measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's ability to form syntactically complex language constructs, generally through the administration of standardised tests or the analysis of language samples by a specialist

items.label: Plasmodium falciparum antigen IgG1 measurement
items.definition: measurement of the IgG1 antibody isotype produced by plasma cells in response to a Plasmodium falciparum infection

items.label: Plasmodium falciparum antigen IgG3 measurement
items.definition: measurement of the IgG3 antibody isotype produced by plasma cells in response to a Plasmodium falciparum infection

items.label: Plasmodium falciparum antigen IgG measurement
items.definition: measurement of the IgG antibody isotype produced by plasma cells in response to a Plasmodium falciparum infection

items.label: cotinine measurement
items.definition: quantification of cotinine in a sample

items.label: refractive error measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of refractive errors, which occur when the shape of the eye prevents light from focusing directly on the retina. items.label: sleep apnea measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of obstructive sleep apnea, such as oxygen desaturation levels during an apnea event or severity, duration or frequency of apnea events

items.label: athletic endurance measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of athletic endurance

items.label: advanced glycation end-product measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of advanced glycation end-products (AGEs), a diverse group of molecules produced by the non-enzymatic addition of glucose to proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids, possibly associated with hyperglycemia and diabetic complications

items.label: cognitive behavioural therapy

items.label: balding measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of balding in an individual

items.label: nighttime rest measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of nighttime rest such as duration or quality

items.label: daytime rest measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of daytime rest such as duration, frequency or quality

items.label: food addiction measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of food addiction such as presence or absence or severity of symptoms, usually assessed through a standarised questionnaire or structured interview with a mental health professional

items.label: alcohol dependence measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of alcohol dependence or misuse, eg using a cummulative symptom score to determine the severity of a case of alcohol dependence

items.label: coenzyme Q10 measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of the amount of coenzyme Q10, a lipophilic redox molecule that is present in membranes of almost all cells in human tissues, is essential for the respiratory transport chain and is a modulator of inflammatory processes and gene expression

items.label: anti-citrullinated protein antibody seropositivity
items.definition: anti-citrullinated protein antibody seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibodies

items.label: pesticide exposure measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of pesticide exposure such as frequency, duration or severity

items.label: cheekbone morphology measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of cheekbone morphology such as cheekbone protrusion

items.label: apolipoprotein A-IV measurement
items.definition: quantification of serum lipoprotein A-IV. Apolipoprotein A-IV, encoded in humans by the APOA4 gene,  a 376-residue mature O-linked glycoprotein.

items.label: solar lentigines measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount or severity of solar lentigines, flat tan to brown spots sometimes called liver spots, on an individual's skin. Lentigines are associated with skin aging and sun exposure

items.label: seroconversion
items.definition: Seroconversion is the process during which a specific antibody develops and becomes detectable in the blood. items.label: knee peak torque measurement
items.definition: quantification of peak torque values of the knee flexor muscles

items.label: facial width measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of facial width, such a the cranial base width

items.label: facial height measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of facial height, such a the height of the entire face or the height of the upper half of the face

items.label: facial depth measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of facial depth, such as the distance from the tip of the nose to the tip of the ear lobe

items.label: body ratio measurement
items.definition: quantification of the ratio between two body measures, eg waist-hip ratio

items.label: illness severity status
items.definition: quantification of the severity of a patient's illness, eg critical or mild

items.label: sulfate measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of sulfate, an inorganic polyatomic anion, in a sample. Sulfate is critical in many organisms in the biotransformation of multiple compounds via sulfotransferase-mediated sulfate conjugation (sulfation).

items.label: cartilage thickness measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the thickness of cartilage in a joint, most commonly the hip joint, for example using minimal joint space width (mJSW) as a proxy measure. Cartilage thickness is an indicator of joint health, which makes it a suitable biomarker for osteoarthritis.

items.label: gut microbiome measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of an individual's micrbiome of the gut

items.label: excessive daytime sleepiness measurement
items.definition: quantification of excessive daytime sleepiness such as how often it occurs and its severity

items.label: insomnia measurement
items.definition: quantification of insomnia such as how often it occurs and its severity

items.label: job-related exhaustion measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of job-related exhaustion such as severity or duration

items.label: microbiome measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of an individual's microbiome

items.label: taxonomic microbiome measurement
items.definition: quantification of the taxonomic variation in a microbiome sample

items.label: functional microbiome measurement
items.definition: quantification of the functional variation in a microbiome

items.label: DDT metabolite measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of the organochlorine pesticide dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT) or any metabolite derived from DDT, eg 2, 2-bis (4-chlorophenyl)-1, 1-dichloroethene (p,p′-DDE)

items.label: age at voice drop
items.definition: The age of onset of (human) voice drop, the deepening of the voice of adolescents as they reach puberty

items.label: dysmenorrheic pain measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of dysmenorrheic pain (menstrual cramps), such as their severity or duration

items.label: donor genotype effect measurement
items.definition: quantification of the effect of the donor genotype on the success of an organ or tissue transplant

items.label: alpha-tocopherol measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of alpha-tocopherol, a form of vitamin E that is preferentially absorbed and accumulated in humans

items.label: gamma-tocopherol measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of gamma-tocopherol

items.label: hepcidin:ferritin ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of hepcidin to ferritin in a sample

items.label: hepcidin:transferrin saturation ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of hepcidin to transferrin saturation, the amount of iron bound to transferrin, in a sample

items.label: magnesium:calcium ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of magnesium to calcium in a sample, typically a urine sample, a proxy measure for the differential handling by the renal tubule and excretion of Ca2+ and Mg2+

items.label: susceptibility to childhood ear infection measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's susceptibility to childhood ear infections, generally as a count of number of infections suffered or a binary scale of presence or absence of childhood ear infections

items.label: joint hypermobility measurement
items.definition: quantification of the severity of joint hypermobility, for example using the Beighton score, a score ranging from 0 to 9 based on 9 different measurements regarding the hypermobility of finger, knee, elbow, thumb and hip hypermobility

items.label: synophrys measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of unibrows, such as their presence or absence, or their severity

items.label: methadone dose measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of methadone dosage

items.label: traffic air pollution measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of air pollution through traffic, such as annual average NO2 exposure estimates derived using land use regression modeling

items.label: CHGA cleavage product measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of chromogranin A cleavage product in a sample

items.label: CHGB cleavage product measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of chromogranin B cleavage product in a sample

items.label: personality trait measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of personality traits, usually through administration of standardised questionnaire such as the Big Five Inventory (BFI)

items.label: conscientiousness measurement
items.definition: quantification of conscientiousness, usually through administration of standardised questionnaire such as the Big Five Inventory (BFI)

items.label: extraversion measurement
items.definition: quantification of extraversion, usually through administration of standardised questionnaire such as the Big Five Inventory (BFI)

items.label: openness measurement
items.definition: quantification of openness, usually through administration of standardised questionnaire such as the Big Five Inventory (BFI)

items.label: agreeableness measurement
items.definition: quantification of agreeableness, usually through administration of standardised questionnaire such as the Big Five Inventory (BFI)

items.label: tonsillectomy risk measurement
items.definition: Quantification an individual's risk of undergoing tonsillectomy. Some individuals experience recurrent, severe tonsillitis and massive hypertrophy of the tonsils in which case surgical removal of the tonsils may be considered. There are a number of genetic variants that may reduce the risk of tonsil

items.label: ventricular rate measurement
items.definition: quantification in an electrocardiogram of the number of QRS complexes per minute

items.label: LDL cholesterol:HDL cholesterol ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of LDL cholesterol to HDL cholesterol in a sample

items.label: radius bone mineral density
items.definition: mineral density of the radial bone

items.label: creatinine clearance measurement
items.definition: The clearance rate of creatinine, that is, the volume of plasma that is cleared of creatinine by the kidneys per unit time. Creatinine clearance is calculated using the level of creatinine in a sample of urine, usually one collected over a period of 24 hours, the corresponding plasma creatinine leve

items.label: disease prognosis measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of disease prognosis

items.label: coronary atherosclerosis measurement
items.definition:

items.label: respiratory symptom measurement
items.definition: quantification of the range and severity of respiratory symptoms, either through clinical examination or through a standardised questionnaire assessing variables such as presence and severity of cough, pleghm and dyspnea

items.label: LDH-related sciatica symptom severity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the severity of sciatica symptoms in patients with lumbar disc herniation. In the case of persistent progressive severe sciatica symptoms, patients may require surgical intervention via microdiscectomy, a minimally invasive spinal surgery for removal of herniated lumbar disc tissue
synonyms: lumbar disc herniation-related sciatica symptom severity measurement

items.label: hip osteoarthritis symptom severity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the hip osteoarthritis symptoms. In the case severe hip osteoarthritis, patients may require surgical intervention via a total hip replacement.

items.label: allergen exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of an individual's level of exposure to an allergen such as a food allergen or dust mites. The level of exposure is defined as units of allergen in a sample, eg microgram of dust mites in a gram of dust.

items.label: tiredness measurement
items.definition: Quantification an individual's level of tiredness, generally via a standardised questionnaire or structured interview.

items.label: monocyte:lymphocyte ratio
items.definition: quantification of the ratio between absolute monocyte count and absolute lymphocyte count

items.label: genotype effect measurement
items.definition: quantification of the effect of an external genotype, eg from a parent/fetus during pregnancy or organ donor, on some aspect of an individual's metabolic processes

items.label: fetal genotype effect measurement
items.definition: quantification of the effect of the fetal genotype on the metabolic processes of the mother during pregnancy

items.label: organochlorine pesticide measurement
items.definition: quantification of organochlorine pesticides or metabolites derived from organochloride pesticides in a sample

items.label: polybrominated biphenyl measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of some polybrominated biphenyls, a group of man-made environmental pollutants which accumulate in humans with adverse health effects

items.label: polybrominated diphenyl ether measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of some polybrominated diphenyl ethers, a group of man-made environmental pollutants which accumulate in humans with adverse health effects

items.label: abnormal paneth cell measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of Paneth cell abnormality, such as abnormal morphology or abnormal number of cells. Paneth cells, along with goblet cells, enterocytes, and enteroendocrine cells, represent the principal cell types of the epithelium of the small intestine.

items.label: gestational serum measurement
items.definition: quantification of some chemical compound such as a metabolite or environmental pollutant in a serum sample taken from a women at some stage during pregnancy

items.label: estrone conjugate measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of estrone conjugates, such as sulphate and glucuronide conjugates, in a sample
